scope: WordPress local desechable; cola, REST y navegador reales. Respuestas HTTP de Supadata simuladas para esta prueba, sin clave ni consumo real. No acredita conexión al servicio real ni publicación.
checks: La clave se configura desde WordPress, vuelve vacía al navegador y el modo nativo queda seleccionado sin generación
La generación adicional se puede activar y desactivar desde el formulario real
El botón Obtener subtítulos inicia la cola real y muestra el estado asíncrono sin pedir Google OAuth
Se guarda y visualiza la transcripción completa con el último segmento después de dos horas
La lectura mantiene contraste y distribución en móvil y escritorio, en ambos temas
Abrir y cerrar la transcripción conserva el comentario en curso
Generar resumen y nota reutiliza la fuente completa guardada y conserva el original
Los asociados conservan acceso al recurso y sus resúmenes; la fuente editorial, credenciales y consultas de pago requieren permisos
Eliminar la clave desde Ajustes funciona y conserva las transcripciones previamente guardadas

phpunit.notes: Controlled negative cases deliberately log provider, delivery, rejected-write and revoked-permission errors; the assertions verify those paths.

architecture.provider: Supadata native by default; optional auto tries existing captions first
architecture.complete_source: 2-hour-5-minute fixture, 1500 timestamped segments, 295521 characters; final segment retained in storage, editor, viewer and existing AI context
architecture.asynchronous: 202 job ID persisted; queued/active deferred in existing queue; complete source saved before multimedia resumes
architecture.cache: 7 days; shared per video/language/credential; existing stored or manual source wins; pending video job reused across a language change
architecture.secret: AES-256-GCM WordPress option, non-autoloaded; constant/environment precedence; explicit external-only server policy respected; no key in REST, URL, audit or browser return
architecture.limits: Conservative account pacing; Retry-After; quota/plan/auth/access errors; bounded transient errors; no automatic billable resubmission after ambiguous initial timeout; explicit retry for failed or expired jobs
architecture.preservation: Up to 2000000 characters and 16 MiB provider responses; invalid or over-limit results fail whole, never silently clipped; full source sent to selected AI without slicing

limitations: Supadata and AI responses are simulated in these local checks. No real Supadata API Key was supplied; the user will configure it later.
No remote deployment, full shared Bruno/Playwright rerun, SonarQube or ZAP run is claimed.

External availability, supported videos, provider plans/credits and the selected AI model context limits still apply. A functioning cron worker is needed to retrieve async results before provider expiry.
temporary_environment_cleanup: completed; isolated containers, volumes, fixture accounts, private access file, uploads and dummy API key removed
